text:
The fastest morning trains to Agra Cantt are the Shatabdi 12002 from New Delhi (6:00 AM to 7:50 AM, 1h 50m) and, from Hazrat Nizamuddin, the Vande Bharat 22470 (6:00 AM to 7:40 AM, 1h 40m) and the Gatimaan 12050 (8:10 AM to 9:50 AM, 1h 40m).

From New Delhi station:

Punjab Mail 12138: 5:10 AM to 8:10 AM, with sleeper and AC classes
Shatabdi 12002: 6:00 AM to 7:50 AM, chair car
Taj Express 12280: 6:55 AM to 9:25 AM, chair car
Hirakund Exp 20808: 8:15 AM to 10:35 AM, with sleeper and AC classes
HSX AGC Exp 11906: 7:20 AM to 11:00 AM, with sleeper and AC classes
Slow passenger train 64074: 4:15 AM to 9:05 AM

The Shatabdi, Taj Express, Punjab Mail and 64074 run daily. The Vande Bharat and Gatimaan leave from Nizamuddin, and their running days weren't clear on the page I read, so check the day before you plan around them. The list I read stopped at 11:25 AM. I didn't book anything.
